productionData.additionalNotes: This one was a little different, I reverse engineered the Whitecard from first taking a frame from the Architects CGI Video, Then using SketchUp Photomatch to align this with SketchUp's axis, Modelled the Orangery from Top's CAD & Base SketchUp File, then bounced out just Vale elements and the missing chimney, then crudely sketched over the image in photoshop before passing it into the Digital Concept 5 Stage Pipeline to get the Final Watercolour Image.
